title: Keys move things
summary: Drive characters with the arrow keys. Learn how x and y change, and make a jump and a glide.
learn: Change x to go left and right, y to go up and down
Plus and minus mean opposite ways
Make a jump with a wait, and a glide

chapters.title: Guide
chapters.idea: The ideas, one at a time

finish.text: You can drive sprites with keys, and make them jump and glide!
remix: Make Robot drive with the W A S D keys.
Make Fox say Wheee! while it glides.

steps.title: Play first
steps.text: Drive Robot around! Press [[Run code]], tap the game, then press the arrow keys [←] [→] [↑] [↓]. Press [space] too.
steps.why: Each key is its own <<signal>>, and each one has its own blocks.

steps.title: One key, one move
steps.text: Robot is in the middle, at <<x>> = 0. ((Events#hat:key|when right arrow key pressed)) runs ((Motion#scene_change|change sprite Robot x by 30)) each time you press [→].

predict.question: You press → three times. What is Robot’s x now?
predict.explain: Each press runs the blocks once: 0 + 30 + 30 + 30 = 90. A bigger x is further right.

steps.why: Change x adds to where the sprite is now, so each press moves it a bit more.

steps.title: Minus goes left
steps.text: Now [←] runs ((Motion#scene_change|change sprite Robot x by -30)). The minus sign means the other way.

predict.question: Robot starts at x = 0. You press ← two times. What is x now?
predict.explain: Minus 30, twice, is -60. A minus x is left of the middle.

steps.title: Up and down are y
steps.text: <<y>> is up and down. [↑] runs ((Motion#scene_change|change sprite Robot y by 20)) and [↓] runs ((Motion#scene_change|change sprite Robot y by -20)).

predict.question: Robot starts at y = -40. You press ↑, ↑, then ↓. What is y now?
predict.explain: -40 + 20 + 20 − 20 = -20. Up adds to y, down takes away.

steps.title: Drive Fox
steps.coach: Change blocks are in Motion. Tap it!
steps.text: Make Fox move right by 10 when you press [→].

checklist.text: Put ((Motion#scene_change|change sprite Fox x by 10)) under it
Run it. Tap the game, then press [→]

hints: Drag ((Events#hat:key|when space key pressed)) out of {{Events}} and choose right arrow in its menu.
Snap ((Motion#scene_change|change sprite Fox x by 10)) from {{Motion}} under it.

quiz.question: Robot starts at x = 0. You press → 5 times. What is Robot’s x?
Robot starts at x = 0. You press → 3 times. What is Robot’s x?
Robot starts at x = 0. You press ← 4 times. What is Robot’s x?
quiz.explain: Minus 10, four times: -40. It went left.

steps.title: Snap it in
steps.text: Snap the loose change block under ((Events#hat:key|when right arrow key pressed)), so [→] moves Robot right.

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Drag the change block by its left edge and drop it under the when block.

steps.title: Left with ←
steps.text: Make Fox move left by 20 each time you press [←].

script.label: Press ← once: Fox is at x -20
Press ← again: Fox is at x -40

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Use ((Events#hat:key|when left arrow key pressed)) from {{Events}}.
Under it, ((Motion#scene_change|change sprite Fox x by -20)). Left is minus.

steps.title: There and back
steps.text: [→] adds 25 to Robot’s x, and [←] takes 25 away.

quiz.question: Robot starts at x = 0. You press →, →, ←, →. What is x now?
Robot starts at x = 0. You press ←, ←, →. What is x now?
Robot starts at x = 0. You press →, ←, →, ←. What is x now?
quiz.explain: Every → is undone by a ←, so Robot is back at 0.

steps.title: Up goes down
steps.text: Pressing [↑] should move Fox up. But Fox goes down! Fix the blocks.

script.label: Press ↑: Fox goes up to y -20

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Up makes y bigger. Is the number plus or minus?

steps.title: Up and down
steps.text: Make Robot go up by 20 with [↑] and down by 20 with [↓].

script.label: Press ↑ twice: Robot is at y 0

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: You need two when blocks: ((Events#hat:key|when up arrow key pressed)) and ((Events#hat:key|when down arrow key pressed)).
Up: ((Motion#scene_change|change sprite Robot y by 20)). Down: ((Motion#scene_change|change sprite Robot y by -20)).

steps.title: Jump!
steps.text: When you press [space], Fox jumps: it goes up 60, waits 0.3 seconds, then comes down 60. The wait block is ((Control#py_wait|wait 1 seconds)).

script.label: Press space: Fox goes up to y 20
and comes back down to y -40

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Three blocks under the space block: change y by 60, wait, change y by -60.
The wait block is in {{Control}}. Type 0.3 in it.
steps.why: Without the wait, Fox would go up and down so fast that you would not see it.

steps.title: Two moves at once
steps.text: Each [→] runs two blocks: change x by 20, then change y by 10.

quiz.question: Robot starts at x = 0, y = -40. You press → twice. Where is Robot?
quiz.explain: Two presses: x goes 0 → 20 → 40, and y goes -40 → -30 → -20.

quiz.question: Robot starts at x = 0, y = -40. You press ← three times. Where is Robot?

steps.title: Glide
steps.text: When you press [space], Robot glides to x 100, y 0 in 1 second. Use ((Motion#scene_glide|glide sprite Robot for 1 seconds to x 100 y 0)).

checklist.text: Press [[Check my answer]]: every check passes

hints: Glide is in {{Motion}}. It moves a little at a time, so you see it slide.
Set seconds to 1, x to 100 and y to 0.

steps.title: Make a dance
steps.text: ★ Make Fox and Robot dance! Try the ideas below, then press Next step when you are happy with it.

checklist.text: Someone jumps with a wait in the middle

steps.title: Show what you know: move
steps.text: Make Fox move right by 15 each time you press [→].

script.label: Press → again: Fox is at x 30

variants.text: Make Fox move up by 25 each time you press [↑].

script.label: Press ↑ again: Fox is at y 10

variants.text: Make Fox move left by 30 each time you press [←].

script.label: Press ← again: Fox is at x -60

steps.title: Show what you know: where is it?
steps.text: [→] adds 15 to Robot’s x, and [↓] takes 10 from its y.

quiz.question: Robot starts at x = 0, y = -40. You press →, →, ↓. Where is Robot?
Robot starts at x = 0, y = -40. You press ↓, ↓, →. Where is Robot?

steps.title: Show what you know: fix it
steps.text: [→] should move Fox right by 10, but Fox goes left. Fix it.

variants.text: Pressing [↓] should move Fox down by 20, but nothing happens when you press ↓. Fix it.

script.label: Press ↓: Fox goes down to y -60
